crossRefs.note: They took soundings, and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen…

translations.web: They took soundings, and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms.
translations.bsb: They took soundings and found that the water was twenty fathoms deep. Going a little farther, they took another set of soundings that read fifteen fathoms.
translations.kjv: And sounded, and found it twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms.
translations.asv: and they sounded, and found twenty fathoms; and after a little space, they sounded again, and found fifteen fathoms.
